 Morocco face Niger on Tuesday 17 November 2026 at 20:00 GMT in Africa Cup of Nations qualifying. Of 18 internationals reviewed, 5 are in form, 12 stable and 1 struggling.

 The match: Niger – Morocco, Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers, Tuesday 17 November 2026
 In form: Achraf Hakimi , Gessime Yassine , Amine Adli , Brahim Díaz , Oussama Targhalline 
 Stable: Bilal El Khannouss , Abdessamad Ezzalzouli , Redouane Halhal , Noussair Mazraoui, Nayef Aguerd and 7 others
 Struggling: Chemsdine Talbi
 The scope: internationals playing in 15 European competitions; this is not the coach’s squad list
 Niger – Morocco, in Africa Cup of Nations qualifying, will be played on Tuesday 17 November 2026 at 20:00 GMT. On the eve of the Atlas Lions’ match, the SNA editorial team reviewed 18 Moroccan internationals playing in the 15 European competitions it follows and who have featured for their clubs since 26 October 2026. The verdict: 5 are in form, 12 stable and 1 struggling. The ranking follows a simple rule: at least two goals or assists, or four starts with an average statistical rating of 7.2 or higher, to be “in form”; no starts or fewer than 150 minutes to be “struggling”.
 Five Lions in form, from Paris Saint Germain to Feyenoord
 Achraf Hakimi has started his last 5 matches for Paris Saint Germain, playing 352 minutes. The defender scored 3 goals and provided 3 assists in that run, with an average statistical rating of 7.6/10.
 At Strasbourg, forward Gessime Yassine has also started his last 4 matches, for 305 minutes. He has 2 goals and 2 assists, with an average statistical rating of 7.0/10.
 Amine Adli, the Bournemouth forward, has scored 2 goals in his last 5 matches, 4 of which he started. His average statistical rating stands at 6.9/10.

 Key figures
 18 Moroccan internationals reviewed 15 European competitions followed 26 October 2026 club appearances since 150 minutes struggling threshold At Real Madrid, Brahim Díaz has provided 2 assists in 5 matches, for 71 minutes of playing time and just one start. His average statistical rating is 6.7/10.
 Feyenoord midfielder Oussama Targhalline has put together 5 starts for 424 minutes. Without a goal or an assist, he makes this category thanks to his average statistical rating, 7.2/10.
 Twelve players stable, from defence to midfield
 In defence, Redouane Halhal (Venezia) has 450 minutes from 5 starts and Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) 425 minutes, also across 5 matches. Noussair Mazraoui has started 3 times for Manchester United and supplied 1 assist. Jawad El Yamiq (Eyüpspor) and Issa Diop (Ipswich) each have 4 starts and 360 minutes.
 In midfield, Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) has scored 1 goal in 5 starts. Abdessamad Ezzalzouli (Real Betis) has totalled 438 minutes, with 1 assist to show for it. Neil El Aynaoui (RB Leipzig) has 407, while Sofyan Amrabat (Ajax) has started his 5 matches for 390 minutes. Ayyoub Bouaddi, at Manchester City, has started 2 of his 4 games for 202 minutes and 1 assist. Ismael Saibari (Bayern Munich) has started 4 times in 223 minutes, Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) 4 times in 215 minutes.
 Only one player struggling
 Chemsdine Talbi, the Sunderland midfielder, has totalled 132 minutes over his last 3 matches, 2 of them starts, below the 150-minute threshold set by the ranking. His average statistical rating is 6.5/10.
 This barometer covers the Moroccan internationals in the 15 European competitions followed by SNA and does not prejudge the coach’s squad list.
